question: List every effect this person attempts, one per line, in the form "<effect> -> <object>". The effects are: wear, restore, reveal, conceal, expose, noise, open, close, leave, take, give, move-person, and reposition-self (the actor moving her own body within the room: standing, stepping, crouching, lying down, crawling, leaning, turning, or going over to something). Name every one you see, INCLUDING reposition-self, and name the object each acts on. Looking for several details on one thing is ONE reveal of it. Speaking, watching and waiting are not effects and are not listed. Answer with the lines and nothing else.
